verdict.rationale: Plugging external MCP servers into an AI-enabled compliance platform is a plausible capability, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Drata's own MCP server, which lets outside AI agents interact with Drata (server role); that belongs to a different story and earns no credit here. Nothing shows Drata acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
